correctness.rationale: Exact enumeration of cyclic triples gives the suspension-plus-edge simplicial equality. Integral homotopy recurrence yields the wedge; involution exchange yields minus on shifted homology and reverses the new H1 edge, inductively establishing (-1)^d. Rational transfer on barycentrically subdivided finite simplicial action yields the quotient formula. The independent finite 12-case GF2 Betti and signed Lefschetz replay corroborated, but no finite computation was used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: For every depth r the natural reflection has an exactly alternating integral orientation character on distinct sphere-homology degrees. A finite symmetry quotient then retains one rational class in each even degree up to r, producing unboundedly rich quotient homology from a sparse nested-fault family. This is geometric equivariant information not recoverable from previously known nonequivariant sphere numbers and is motivated by orientation-fault sensitivity of directed flag topology.
